header: # Town of Shoreham -- item-9 follow-up, 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Shoreham, 2025 Annual Town Report, officers table: Auditors -- Timothy Steady, 3 years (2023-2026); Sarah Gosselin (APPOINTED), 3 years (2024-2027); Tamra Hawley-House, 3 years (2025-2028). Steady's term expired in 2026 and Gosselin no longer sits (the town's current auditors page lists Hawley-House, Jarboe-Singletary and Treadway); both memberships are ended in 2026 in the hand-edits step. Gosselin is recorded appointed, as the report tags her.
